subject: MAP & licensing: Private VPC evaluation plan and commercial milestones
messages:
From: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@apexhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Apex Health Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + Private VPC eval — timeline & commercial guide

Rafael, Laura —

Thanks for the demo earlier. Our security and infra teams are comfortable running a Private VPC evaluation but procurement needs a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and commercial guardrails before we start. A few things we need spelled out: 

- Evaluation scope and acceptance criteria (so infra signs off)
- Milestone timeline (POC start, acceptance, full rollout)
- Pricing during eval vs post-commit (including any platform fee for Private deployment)
- Commit levels and expected ramp (we expect to scale quickly if performance matches)
- Any discounts tied to commit / milestones, and refund/credit policy if service doesn’t meet SLA

Can you share a MAP draft with pricing tied to milestone attainment? Procurement asked for a single spreadsheet and a short one-pager they can circulate to legal.

Also include SOC2 evidence pointer — they will circulate to their InfoSec.

Best,
Maria
Director, Product & Platform
Apex Health
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Apex Health Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Private VPC eval — timeline & commercial guide

Maria —

Appreciate the clear ask. Attached is a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (Apex_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short commercial summary. High level proposal below; I can update the sheet to match any edits you have.

Proposed MAP (6-week POC -> rollout):
1) Week 0: Kickoff & infra prep (VPC peering, KMS keys)
2) Weeks 1–4: POC run (20 concurrent sessions, up to 250k tokens/day)
   - Acceptance: 95th pct response latency <350ms, feature parity on top-3 prompts and privacy controls
3) Week 5: Acceptance testing & CAS sign-off
4) Week 6: Transition to reserved capacity (if accepted)

Commercials (structure):
- Evaluation pricing: subsidized run-rate during POC (flat platform fee waived for POC if we receive a signed MAP and a non-binding LOI).
- Platform fee (Private/VPC): one-time setup + ongoing platform license. Options: 
   A) One-time platform fee $75k + monthly platform license $6k/mo 
   B) Reduced one-time platform fee $35k if customer commits to 12 months reserved capacity (see commit schedule)
- Reserved capacity commit tiers: 3/6/12 months with increasing discounts (5% / 10% / 18% on per-token rates) and additional platform license credit at 12m.
- Milestone discounts: additional 5% discount applied at 3-month ramp target if token usage >= agreed ramp schedule.
- SLA credit & refund language: standard Redwood terms; we can surface a limited service credit for missed availability during POC acceptance window.

Attachments referenced: Apex_MAP_v1.xlsx (map, milestones, pricing bands), commercial_summary_APX.pdf

If that initial structure looks good I’ll produce MAP v2 with explicit numbers per tier and include a DocuSign-ready LOI for the non-binding commit.

Rafael
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@apexhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Apex Health Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + Private VPC eval — timeline & commercial guide

Thanks Rafael — this is helpful. Quick clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Can you spell out what counts as ‘ramp target’ (absolute tokens/day or concurrency)? We prefer absolute monthly committed tokens.
- For platform fee reduction tied to 12-month commit: does that require payment up front, or can it be amortized monthly?
- SOC2 evidence: we need a short readme or a S3 link that we can send to InfoSec.

If you can provide MAP v2 with those specifics we'll circulate to legal. We prefer a one-page summary for execs and the spreadsheet for procurement. Also, can you confirm if Redwood supports a market-standard mutual NDA and whether any customer data will leave the VPC during POC?

-Maria
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Apex — concession options & platform fee negotiation (confidential)

Team —

Quick internal note before I send MAP v2 to Apex: procurement is pushing hard on platform fee amortization and an aggressive ramp. I want to propose a compromise we can lean on: 

- Offer amortized platform fee over first 6 months for 12-month commit (i.e., $35k split into $5.8k/mo credit). 
- Keep one-time setup fee for shorter commits (3/6 months) at $45k. 
- Add milestone-based credits: if they meet 3-month token target (X = 2.5M tokens/mo) give a $10k credit toward platform license applied in month 4.
- Approve up to extra 3% markdown off per-token rates for VP approval only; anything beyond that requires CRO sign-off.

Also confirm we should include the SOC2-readme.pdf link in the external package (I think yes).

If ok I’ll finalize MAP v2 and include two commercial paths (amortized vs upfront).

Rafael
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Apex Health Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: MAP v2 (final) — commercial options & milestone schedule

Maria —

Attached is MAP_v2 (Apex_MAP_v2.xlsx) and a one-page commercial summary (commercial_summary_APX.pdf). Highlights: 

1) POC acceptance criteria and ramp targets (explicit):
   - 3-week rolling target: 750k tokens/week (≈3M tokens/month) to qualify for 3-month milestone credit
   - 95th pct latency <350ms on agreed prompts
2) Pricing & platform fee options:
   Option 1 — 12m commit (recommended):
     - One-time platform fee: $35,000 amortized over first 6 months as a credit ($5,833/mo)
     - Reserved capacity discount: 18% on base per-token rates
     - Additional $10k milestone credit if 3-month ramp target met
   Option 2 — 6m commit:
     - One-time platform fee: $45,000 upfront
     - Reserved capacity discount: 10%
   Option 3 — POC only (no commit):
     - Waived one-time platform fee for POC with a subsidized per-token eval rate; full platform fee applies on conversion
3) DocuSign LOI link included for the non-binding 12m path if you’d like rapid internal sign-off: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/0X1A2B3C4D
4) SOC2: attached SOC2-readme.pdf (contains S3 links and evidence pointers).

If you’re comfortable with Option 1, we can issue a HubSpot quote and a DocuSign LOI today; legal typically needs 48–72 hours to complete the contract for Private deployments.

Best,
Rafael

Attachments: Apex_MAP_v2.xlsx, commercial_summary_APX.pdf, SOC2-readme.pdf
From: Apex Health Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Maria Gonzales <maria.gonzales@apexhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP v2 (final) — commercial options & milestone schedule

Rafael —

Thanks for the crisp MAP v2 and the options. Procurement will review the two commercial paths with Legal next week. A couple asks before we route: 

1) Please confirm whether the amortized platform fee requires a signed payment schedule or if we can include it in the invoice terms (Net30).
2) We need a short exec call (30 minutes) to lock timelines with our CTO and Head of Ops — can you propose a time on Wed or Thu next week?
3) SOC2 links look good; InfoSec will follow up if they need more.

If the amortized schedule can be Net30 invoiced rather than prepayment, that will help us recommend Option 1 internally.

Procurement (on behalf of Apex Health)
